newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in April.
newsitem.headline: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in April.

text.p: Italy had a 3.604 trillion lire trade surplus with non-European Union countries in April, the national statistics office ISTAT said.
ITALY TRADE BALANCE (NON-EU) April 97 March 97 April 96
Cumulative yr to date +10.587 trln +6.983 trln +9.611 trln
Imports yr to date 45.018 trln 33.100 trln 44.828 trln
Exports yr to date 55.605 trln 40.083 trln 54.439 trln
Istat gave the following breakdown for the trade balance with European Union countries for March.
Cumulative yr to date +2.737 trln +1.761 trln +3.425 trln
Note -- Istat said that Italy had a global trade surplus in March of 4.428 trillion lire against a surplus of 5.307 trillion lire in March 1996.
